summary: Etsy Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a modification to its previously announced sale of Depop to eBay Inc. The purchase price is ~$1.2 billion, subject to adjustments for pre-closing investments. The expected close was pushed from Q2 to Q3 2026. The Purchase Agreement includes a $90 million termination fee for regulatory clearance failure and a potential additional $70 million fee. A new Letter Agreement allows Etsy and Depop to continue investing in Depop and provides for an additional termination fee ranging from $0 to $136 million depending on termination date. The board is not specified. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and risks of fee triggers.
